arguments.Code: using UnityEngine; using UnityEngine.UI; using InhaExpress.Client.Presentation; using InhaExpress.Client.MapClient; internal class CommandScript : IRunCommand { public void Execute(ExecutionResult result) { var hud=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<WebClientHud>(); var map=Object.FindFirstObjectByType<CampusServerMap>(); result.Log("hud="+(hud!=null)+" run="+map?.RunId+" error="+map?.LastError); foreach(var c in Object.FindObjectsByType<UnityAutonomousClient>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) result.Log("vehicle="+c.VehicleId+" connected="+c.Connected+" reserved="+c.TransportReserved+" status="+c.Status); foreach(var d in Object.FindObjectsByType<Dropdown>(FindObjectsSortMode.None)) result.Log("dropdown="+d.name+" count="+d.options.Count); ScreenCapture.CaptureScreenshot("artifacts/high_speed_drive/request-ui-before.png"); } }
